purpose: Try to falsify universal crossing-free nearest-two arrival order using a necessary geometric ear condition on strictly convex point sets; run exhaustive arrival-order solver only on no-ear witness candidates.
bounds: Fixed seed 150128; n=4..12; at most 500 generated integer candidate sets per n (three predefined convex-seeking generators); requires distinct sites, no collinear triples, and every point an extreme vertex; stop at first verified no-ear convex set or 75 elapsed seconds after a checked iteration.
environment: Linux container CPython 3.13.5, Python stdlib only
stopping_rule: First convex point set with no nearest-two hull ear (negative answer if independently verified); else all planned candidate sets; else elapsed-time cap checked per iteration; no posthoc increase. DFS capped at 300000 nodes if invoked.
